abstract: Teratomas of extragonadal origin are extremely rare. The most common extragonadal site is the greater omentum. A 36-year-old woman was referred to our department for treatment of bilateral ovarian tumors. A 3- to 4-cm mass was observed in each ovary; bilateral ovarian mature cystic teratoma was diagnosed through imaging studies. The patient underwent single-port laparoscopic surgery, during which we found not only bilateral ovarian mature cystic teratomas but also an omental tumor macroscopically similar to the ovarian teratomas. The ovarian and omental teratomas were successfully removed through single-port laparoscopic surgery. The histopathological diagnosis of the omental tumor was parasitic mature cystic teratoma.
abstract_ja: 性腺外由来の奇形腫は極めて稀である。最も一般的な性腺外部位は大網である。36歳の女性が、両側卵巣腫瘍の治療目的で当科に紹介された。両側の卵巣にそれぞれ3～4 cmの腫瘤が認められ、画像検査により両側卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。患者は単孔式腹腔鏡手術を受けた。手術中、両側卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫だけでなく、肉眼的に卵巣奇形腫と類似する大網腫瘍も発見された。卵巣および大網の奇形腫は、単孔式腹腔鏡手術により摘出に成功した。大網腫瘍の病理組織学的診断は寄生性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。
